column3: “In every way” renders περὶ … πάντων (“concerning all things”); “enjoy good health” renders “be in good health.”
“Your devotion to the truth” renders “your truth” (“bearing witness of you to the truth”); “in which you continue to walk” recasts “even as you walk in truth.”
BSB follows the critical text: “and especially since they are strangers to you” renders τοῦτο ξένους (“and this, strangers”); the Textus Receptus has “and to the strangers.”
“To the church” renders “before [the] church”; “send them on their way” renders προπέμψας (“having sent forward”).
BSB adds “about this” and renders “does not welcome us” as “will not accept our instruction.” “Who loves to be first” leaves out “among them.”

“I will call attention to his malicious slander against us” compresses “I will bring to remembrance his works which he is doing, prating against us with evil words.” “Refuses to welcome” renders “does not receive.”
BSB adds “good” before “testimony” and “for him” after “testify.”
“I would prefer not to do so” renders “I do not desire … to write to you.”
BSB adds “Instead” and includes here the greetings that form verse 15 in the Greek. “Face to face” renders “mouth to mouth”; “here” and “there” are added.
BSB has no text at this verse number; its content is in verse 14.
